verdict.rationale: Moss is a semantic search runtime. Its documented capabilities are retrieval: hybrid search, embeddings, indexing, and exposing search tools to external agents through MCP, LangChain and the Vercel AI SDK. Nothing in the evidence shows the product itself generating insights or suggestions from a user's data. Retrieval primitives that an external LLM could use are developer building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
